summary: Surface stale carriers and selected-checkout writes in work admission; discover host contract from registered checkouts

delivery.outcome: Work admission explains a WIP slot held by a stale carrier of an integrated ticket, exposes uncommitted writes in the selected checkout with an opt-in digest CAS, and the user host pointer discovers governance from registered checkouts. Publish through independent review.
nonGoals: No change to the status-projection activity default or terminal receipt validation.
No automatic cleanup, handoff or authority from modification times.
No history rewrite or weakening of independent publication.

architecture.decision: Add read-only observations and explicit blockers to the existing admission report instead of changing activity resolution; keep the digest CAS opt-in; replace only the managed pointer paragraph in user instruction files.
interfaceChanges: Report blockers add integrated-ticket-carrier and selected-checkout-changed reasons.
Report worktrees add dirtyNewestModifiedAt; work_start_check accepts --expect-dirty-digest.
The user host pointer paragraph is replaced by a registered-checkout discovery rule.
architecture.rollback: Revert via an independently reviewed follow-up; reports without the new fields remain readable.

validation.evidence: Regression reproducing a dirty carrier of a merged ticket in a checkout behind the target: RECONCILE with an explicit blocker, activity unchanged.
Selected checkout dirty overlap requirement, stable modification observation and blocking digest mismatch.
Fresh and legacy user pointers converge to one current paragraph while other private instructions are preserved.
